runs.name: bg-first-rejected
runs.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: finished portrait 9:16 background illustration for a Chinese playful object-stacking mobile game's HOME poster. Create a densely layered, whimsical TOY CITY under a vivid cyan-blue sky. Match a polished soft 2.5D hand-painted casual game illustration: chunky simplified forms, warm peach yellow and cream with salmon pink, mint and powder blue, luminous soft edges, rounded square window holes, gentle dimensional shading with restrained detail. This is a fanciful city assembled from small children's building blocks, slightly wonky verticals and funny irregular stacked shapes. MANY narrow short towers and small buildings, 2 to 6 stories each, densely overlapping in several layers and at different heights. The skyline starts 32 percent down at the edges and dips to 65 percent down in the middle. Near buildings crop into left and right edges, but they are varied detached small blocks, not continuous walls. Several far blue/purple pastel towers remain visible through the center and behind the future hero. Fill the lower two-thirds with the miniature city and green round tree clusters. Use airy atmospheric perspective: near peach and yellow buildings, progressively softer and paler blue distant buildings. The view is a cheerful front-view upward look at the city, like a toy town storybook poster, not architectural rendering. Avoid a symmetrical street canyon. Do not create a road, a boulevard, vanishing pavement, large plaza, sharp pavement slabs, rails, metallic rooftop water tanks or realistic glass facades. The tiny bottom strip can have softly painted warm cream toy blocks/ground, at most six percent of total height. Upper 25 percent clear bright blue sky for the logo. Between 30 and 85 percent down leave the middle 35 percent less contrasted for a separately composited hero, but it is not an empty gap: faint buildings in the far distance. Clouds are small soft scattered puffs near edges and blue sky; no giant cloud bed. Soft white sunlight, colorful fun rounded game-poster illustration. High quality rich shaded volume, clean finished art. No characters, no duck, no toilet, no storage bin, no shoes, no text, no signboards, no logos, no interface, no button, no photography, no precise architectural window grids, no line drawing. Full bleed finished artwork.

Rich warm pastel colors, soft shaded corners, atmospheric 2.5D illustration. Background layout: bright clear CYAN BLUE SKY at upper 25 percent. runs.name: logo-first
runs.prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Asset type: finished transparent game logo for a polished lighthearted Chinese stacking mobile game. The ONLY main title is exactly four Chinese glyphs: 这也能叠 . Set the four glyphs in ONE very broad compact line, thick cheerful inflated custom Chinese display letters with round corners, colored front faces and dark navy bold outlines, a thin electric-blue outer edge and small dark-blue dimensional extrusion. The three glyphs 这也能 have sunny yellow tops with warm orange lower edges; 叠 is bright sky-blue with light blue highlights. Make a gentle playful arch, not a steep rising diagonal: left and right bottoms close to level, center letters slightly lifted. Overall main lettering width about 900 units and height 310 units. Keep each glyph readable and correctly written. Small golden three-point crown above 叠. A glossy red smiling slide slipper with three white stripes peeks out from BEHIND the top LEFT side of the title, tilted slightly counterclockwise, mostly concealed by the first two letters. Under the main lettering add a SINGLE cream-yellow curved slogan ribbon, golden yellow thin border, rounded ends, subtle shaded thickness. The ribbon closely follows the shallow arch under the lettering and reads exactly: 把乱七八糟的东西叠上天 . The slogan is dark navy-blue bold, large, crisp, evenly spaced Chinese text centered INSIDE the ribbon, one line. The ribbon is approximately 75 percent the width of the title. Keep the entire composition wide and compact, total visible aspect ratio around 1.85:1, title about two-thirds of total height, crown/slipper small accents. Cheerful high-end mobile casual game poster logo; rich smooth shaded paint, restrained shiny highlights, warm joyful colors. Not flat vector, not realistic metal, no neon light glow, no glitter, no background, no extra icons, no extra words, no English, no repeated title. Render a genuinely transparent background with clean alpha and generous small clear margin around all edges. All text must be complete and legible. Finished production logo, no mockup scene.
